# Jačaona

> Jačaona ("place of strengthening") is the first Croatian sports incubator — a non-profit sports association (Sportsko rekreativno društvo Jačaona, founded 2011, OIB 06688496520) that provides space, equipment and know-how to coaches and instructors starting new sports clubs and sections in Zagreb, Croatia.

Key facts:

- Location: Pierottijeva 11, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia (72 m² hall in the former Medika pharmaceutical factory)
- Contact: WhatsApp +385 91 5050 644 (fastest response), info@jacaona.com
- Founded: 2011, by a group of sports competitors and enthusiasts from Zagreb; volunteer-run, non-profit
- Active sections: group strength training, Contemporary Movement, Open Gym, JačaONA (women's training), functional training, Kvir kolektiv, Wing Chun, Crobran
- Values: inclusion, anti-racism, anti-sexism, anti-fascism, anti-ageism; a safe and supportive training environment for everyone
- Legal/finance details: IBAN HR26 2484008-1102787158, OIB 06688496520, registration number 21003537
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/jacaona/ | https://www.instagram.com/jacaona/ | https://www.linkedin.com/company/jacaona/
